basic_info.description: Welcome to your dream home in the Mission District! This stunning 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo is located on the top floor of a well-maintained building and boasts a host of modern upgrades. The newly remodeled kitchen features elegant shaker-style cabinets, sleek grey quartz countertops, and stainless steel appliances. The modern bathroom is designed for comfort and convenience, featuring a shower over the tub and a stylish vanity. Both bedrooms are generously sized, offering spacious closets that provide ample storage space. The unit is adorned with beautiful hardwood floors throughout, enhancing its warm and inviting ambiance. Enjoy the benefits of double-paned windows, which ensure a quiet and energy-efficient environment. Ceiling fans are installed for your comfort. Step outside to the common area and relax in the well-maintained garden, complete with a BBQ area perfect for entertaining. The building also offers a washer and dryer for your convenience. Your unit includes one assigned parking space. Natural light floods this home, creating a bright and cheerful atmosphere. Situated within walking distance to Dolores Park, you'll have easy access to popular restaurants, shops, coffee shops, bars, and a gym.
